title: The Matrix Awakens, Xbox Series X|S, build 1.20.1831.3754
host: TuxBox on Linux, Valve Proton Experimental, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER
run: Headless X11 retail run with the reduced-effects profile, authored film grain, and audio disabled. Keyboard input confirmed Start Chase after the menu appeared.

comparison.result: VKD3D rejected additional geometry/pixel pairs while streaming the opening sequence. Slot 86 returned E_INVALIDARG and Unreal reported a GPU error.

dynamic_linking.frame_context: The Wake Up sequence displayed Morpheus in the white room. The log continued to report decoded 3840 × 1600 HEVC frames.

blocker.observation: The provider stopped at its unsupported-method handler. The call site selects a whole-resource copy while the allocator flushes pending work.
